name: Prepare

Cold hands drop knives. Dock children learn to warm their hands before they learn to steal, and never at a fire another has lit. A borrowed fire is a debt, and the docks collect.

The fires on the Citadel side burn more than wood.. Illustrate that specific action or concept clearly in a grounded ruined medieval dark fantasy world. Rich painted material detail, dramatic readable lighting, ash, old stone, worn iron, muted earth with appropriate restrained magical color. Composition portrait 2:3, 1024x1536.
